dict.string: Notch listens through your microphone while you dictate, and adds it to screen recordings when you switch MIC on there. Nothing is sent anywhere.
Notch turns what you dictate into text on this Mac. Nothing is sent anywhere.
Notch shows your camera as a mirror when you press CAM, and puts it in a screen recording only when you switch CAM on there. Nothing is sent anywhere.
Notch hears what the Mac is playing while you dictate with HEAR THE MAC'S SOUND TOO switched on. Nothing is sent anywhere.
Notch saves your shots and recordings to the Desktop. Nothing is sent anywhere.
